body.objective: Determine whether the order-lambda2 spectator self-energy in the complete tagged q6 ledger survives on a legitimate fixed auxiliary BT carrier, and eliminate it only if an explicit local renormalization condition supplies an operator-level certificate.
activates: an exhaustive auxiliary two-point graph classification through order lambda2
a complete local counterterm basis on the selected auxiliary carrier
a conditional two-term tagged q6 ledger if the spectator block vanishes
body.current_gate: Use the quartic auxiliary interaction to enumerate every connected two-point graph at coupling degree two, classify all neutral ghost-even local counterterms of dimension at most four, and test the massless unit-residue normal-ordering condition on the exact finite-time packet operator rather than only on an asymptotic amplitude.
body.stop_condition: Land a strict coefficient certificate and independent verifier that either proves S2_spectator=0 on a fully declared auxiliary renormalization scheme or retains it as missing; distinguish a selected scheme from a convention forced by the public Letter and preserve all Eq. 19, gravity and Lorentzian boundaries.
body.forbid: no tadpole discarded without a declared normal-ordering/mass condition; no phi-frame wave-function pole inserted again after a complete auxiliary similarity pullback; no selected scheme called uniquely public or scheme independent; no active loop called computed; no scalar result called gravity or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics
body.resource_hint: In the fixed O(1,1) auxiliary frame each Omega^2 Upsilon^2 vertex has degree lambda2. For E=2, 4V=E+2I and L=I-V+1, so degree two has uniquely V=1,I=1,L=1: a tadpole. Cross-only contractions make it a momentum-independent Omega-Upsilon mass term. Normal ordering removes the self-contraction; massless and unit-residue conditions fix the two allowed local two-point counterterms. If this is certified, S2_s tensor A2 vanishes and only the active one-loop cross remains missing at q6.
